environment.description: EKS pod running the gRPC server in namespace 'services'. The Lambda function URL (LAMBDA_FUNCTION_URL) is configured with AuthType=NONE, meaning any HTTP request reaching the URL is processed without IAM signature verification. The Lambda function internally checks the x-custom-role header to determine authorization level. The EKS pod's service account has no specific IAM role attached. Network policy allows egress to all destinations. The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type LoadBalancer with no authentication middleware.

config.grpc_exposure: LoadBalancer, no mTLS, no auth interceptor
